en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Sa’alba Bin Maymoun, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(The narrator) says, ‘I asked Abu Ja’far
<sup>asws</sup> testimony of the blind. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, when it is proved’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from Tha‘labah ibn Maymun from Muhammad ibn Qays who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about the testimony of a blind man. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is admissible if he has preserved it.’”
